text: Hi, I’m Katie. Let me walk you through the Tringg dashboard, from your daily overview to your voice agent.
This is your overview. At a glance you see today’s bookings, pending requests, how many calls came in, and your no-show rate.
Up top, your agent Sofie is live. Share this number to try her out yourself.
On the right, Sofie’s call stats and your most recent calls, each with a short AI summary.
Reservations is your inbox. Bookings Sofie takes arrive here. Switch between today, declined, and expired, and filter by status, date, or party size.
Missed a booking taken by phone or in person? Log it here so everything lives in one place.
Calls shows every conversation Sofie has had, with totals for calls, reservations, average duration, and capture rate.
Filter by completed, transferred, FAQ, or failed, and search by caller name or phone number.
Open any call for an AI summary, tags for what the caller wanted, and the details Sofie captured, like the occasion, number of guests, date, and contact information.
Scroll down to play the recording and read the full transcript, turn by turn.
Agents is where you manage your voice agent. Sofie handles reservations for your outlet, and you can see her calls at a glance.
Edit her settings, manage which outlets she answers for, or press Listen to hear her.
Need another agent for a different outlet? Create one here. You can pause an agent any time, and calls still forward.
That’s the Tringg dashboard. Overview, reservations, calls, and agents, all in one place. Thanks for watching.
